name: Web Browser / Client Application
description: A web browser or client application — also called the SPA, frontend, browser client, mobile/desktop app, or user agent — the untrusted client software through which end users interact, rendering the UI and holding tokens, session state, and cached data client-side. Runs entirely outside server control. The place to look for the browser, frontend/SPA, client app, or the user-side software rendering the interface and holding session data.
